jsesh.mdcDisplayer.draw
Interface DrawingSpecifications

All Known Implementing Classes:
SimpleDrawingSpecifications
public interface DrawingSpecifications

Represent all information needed to draw a text, save the text itself : the various lines width, spacing, the fonts to use, etc. Some more attention should be given to the units used ?!?
